title: fix(mcp): the record data tools and the record resource answer a driver's own error code (SQLITE_BUSY) as /api/v1/data does, never the driver's text
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X3apZSKwFDd6zvjM4gJPKAy)_

Fixes #31273

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的六个记录数据工具(`query_records`、`aggregate_records`、`get_record`、`create_record`、`update_record`、`delete_record`)、`delete_records` 的选择读取和记录资源,遇到驱动自带的错误码(如 `SQLITE_BUSY`)时,改按 `/api/v1/data` 的判定作答:`500 DATABASE_ERROR` `Internal data error`,驱动原文和错误码只记服务端日志一次。
- 为什么改:之前这些面先走"带码即拒绝"的路径,智能体拿到 `{ code: 'SQLITE_BUSY', message: 'SQLITE_BUSY: database is locked' }` 且没有 status;`/data` 门对同一异常判为服务端故障并隐去原文。
- 判定规则(全部是门自己的读法,无副本):抛出的码**没有声明 HTTP status**(`serverFaultProvenance` 为 `'undeclared'`,即 2026-08-27 #12509 裁定:区分依据是 status 通道,不看码的拼写),**且** `/data` 门(`mapDataError`)把它判为服务端故障,才改答门的故障。`thrownRefusalEnvelope` 本身不动,所以 `run_action` / `resume_run` 和元数据工具(#31271 / #31272)不受影响。
- 风险:该裁定的已知代价随之到了这些面上——一个只写了码、没写 status、门又不当作拒绝的抛出(例如不带 status 的 `RECORD_LOCKED`)现在也回门的 `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`,码不再外发;生产代码里在数据路径上没找到这种抛出(见 Acceptance notes)。带 status 的码(`RECORD_LOCKED`/409、`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`/503)、门当作拒绝的无 status 码(`PERMISSION_DENIED`,门答 403)、沙箱带码拒绝都照旧。只改 `@objectstack/mcp`,patch。回滚即还原 `dataDoorRefusalEnvelope` 的三处调用。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `dataDoorRefusalEnvelope`;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` 末尾的 #31273 describe 和记录资源 describe 里的 #31273 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31273`,预期 15 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`dataDoorRefusalEnvelope(err, objectName)` (new, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`) is `thrownRefusalEnvelope` for a face the `/api/v1/data` door serves. It returns the coded envelope unless both of the door's own reads say the throw is an undeclared server fault:

- `serverFaultProvenance(resolveThrownHttpError(err)) === 'undeclared'` (`@objectstack/types`): the producer declared no status. This is the reader the 2026-08-27 ruling on #12509 put in place to withhold a driver errno at every door ("the discriminator is the status channel, not the code's shape").
- `isServerFault(dataDoorAnswerOf(err, objectName).status)`: the door's `mapDataError` answers a 5xx.

When both hold, the face renders the door's answer and logs it once through `logServerFault`, the path a code-less fault already takes. Three call sites read it:

- `dataDoorErrorResult`, so all six record data tools;
- `delete_records`' outer catch, for a coded throw only. A code-less throw there keeps `errorResultWithCode`, as #31246 ruled;
- the record resource catch in `MCPServerRuntime.bridgeResources` (`mcp-server-runtime.ts`).

`thrownRefusalEnvelope` is unchanged. No export was added to `@objectstack/types`: both readers were already public. The new function is exported from its module only, for the resource. `packages/mcp/src/index.ts` re-exports `mcp-http-tools.js` by name and does not list it.

| Throw | Before (tools / resource) | Now | `/api/v1/data` (`mapDataError`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SQLITE_BUSY` `'SQLITE_BUSY: database is locked'`, no status | `{ code: 'SQLITE_BUSY', message: DRIVER_TEXT }`, no status | `{ code: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: 'Internal data error', status: 500 }`, logged once | `500 DATABASE_ERROR` `Internal data error` |
| `ECONNRESET` `'socket hang up'`, no status | `{ code: 'ECONNRESET', message: 'socket hang up' }` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` `Internal server error`, logged once | same |
| `RECORD_LOCKED`, no status | `{ code: 'RECORD_LOCKED', message }` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` `Internal server error` (the ruling's stated cost) | same |
| CONTROL `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 | coded | unchanged | `409 RECORD_LOCKED` |
| CONTROL coded sandboxed refusal (`RECORD_LOCKED` / 409) | coded, the body's sentence | unchanged | `409 RECORD_LOCKED` |
| CONTROL `PERMISSION_DENIED`, no status | `{ code, message }` | unchanged | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| CONTROL `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503 (declared) | coded, its prose | unchanged | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` `Internal server error` (out of scope, see below) |

On the resource, the same answers use its `{ error, code, status }` members.

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`:

- New describe "the record data tools: a driver's own string code is the /data door's server fault (#31273)". It covers the six data tools and `delete_records`.
  - `SQLITE_BUSY` on each of the seven faces: exactly `{ code: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: 'Internal data error', status: 500 }`, equal to `mapDataError`'s answer. Neither `SQLITE_BUSY` nor the driver text is in the answer. One `[5xx] 500 tools/call TOOL task — ` log line carries the driver text.
  - `ECONNRESET`: the door's `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.
  - `RECORD_LOCKED` with no status: the door's `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.
  - CONTROLs on every face: `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 and a coded sandboxed refusal keep their coded answers, unlogged. `PERMISSION_DENIED` with no status keeps `{ code, message }`. `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503 keeps its coded answer.
- Record-resource describe, new "#31273" block:
  - `SQLITE_BUSY`: the exact body `{"error":"Internal data error","code":"DATABASE_ERROR","status":500}`, equal to the door's. One `[5xx] 500 resources/read objectstack://objects/task/records/t1 — ` line carries the driver text.
  - CONTROL: the declared 503 and the status-less `PERMISSION_DENIED` keep their coded bodies, unlogged.

<details><summary>Red first and ablations</summary>

Red first on `f8c3ecc4` (`main`, after PR #31300), with the new pins and no fix: `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` + `mcp-delete-records.test.ts` gave `Tests 10 failed | 131 passed (141)`. The failures were the seven tool `SQLITE_BUSY` rows, the resource `SQLITE_BUSY` row, `ECONNRESET` and the status-less `RECORD_LOCKED`; every CONTROL passed. With the fix: `Tests 141 passed (141)`.

Ablations, each via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head. Every run printed `ok mutation landed` and then `ok restored: blob == HEAD … git diff HEAD is empty`.

1. In `dataDoorRefusalEnvelope`, the door-fault decline was replaced by `return envelope`, so the coded path always wins. Blob `0ff325744a3f -> 39ba2308ac8d`, `Tests 10 failed | 131 passed (141)`: the same ten rows as red first.
2. The provenance limb was removed. Blob `0ff325744a3f -> dbdc2756912c`, `Tests 3 failed | 138 passed (141)`: both declared-5xx CONTROLs and #23509's "a coded non-sandbox refusal renders its own message byte for byte".
3. The door-fault read was replaced by a constant 500, so every undeclared coded throw is declined. Blob `0ff325744a3f -> 22dbeb0972dc`, `Tests 4 failed | 137 passed (141)`: the status-less `PERMISSION_DENIED` CONTROLs and two older status-less pins.
4. `delete_records`' catch was put back on `errorResultWithCode`. Blob `0ff325744a3f -> b7bb78b5ff49`, `Tests 1 failed | 140 passed (141)`: the `delete_records` row.
5. The resource catch was put back on `thrownRefusalEnvelope`. Blob `ee07dd30a5c5 -> 13f4fc4cbbe2`, `Tests 1 failed | 140 passed (141)`: the resource row.

The tests import the package's source, so no `dist/` is involved.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured the door before choosing the rule.** `mapDataError(v, 'task')` was read on 17 thrown values. The door never reads a driver code's spelling: `SQLITE_BUSY` reaches `DATABASE_ERROR` through the message heuristic (`looksLikeInternalErrorLeak`), and `SQLITE_BUSY` with plain text reaches `INTERNAL_ERROR`. Status-less codes the door answers as faults: `SQLITE_BUSY`, `ECONNRESET`, `40P01`, `RECORD_LOCKED`, `NOT_FOUND`, and an app's own code. Status-less codes it refuses: `PERMISSION_DENIED` (403), the unique-violation codes (409 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`), `SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_NOTNULL` (400), and a coded sandboxed abort (400). So "driver-native" here is the door's own reading: no declared status, and a 5xx at the door.
- **The ruling's cost.** A code thrown with no status that the door does not refuse (for example `RECORD_LOCKED` with no `status`) loses its code on these faces, as at the door. A grep of `objectql`, `runtime`, `core`, `types` and `plugins` sources for `Object.assign(new Error(…), { code: 'X' })` with no status found one hit, `plugin-auth`'s admin user import. That is not an MCP data path. The changeset tells producers to declare the status they mean.
- **`Clause-②: no`, re-declared from measurement.** The answer keys are unchanged. Only the values for an undeclared coded fault move to the door's (code, sanitised sentence, status). Nothing in `packages/spec` is touched, and no export was added to a published package's entry.
- **Not touched:** `run_action` / `resume_run` (#31271, PR #31315) and the metadata tools and `list_actions` (#31272, PR #31310). `thrownRefusalEnvelope` and their catches are byte-identical. A probe outside the commit drove 10 thrown values through all 13 tools and the record resource, 140 answers, on `f8c3ecc4` and on the head. Exactly 24 answers moved: `SQLITE_BUSY`, `ECONNRESET` and the status-less `RECORD_LOCKED` on the 8 faces above. None of `list_objects`, `describe_object`, `validate_expression`, `list_actions`, `run_action` or `resume_run` moved on any value.
- **Out of scope, found while measuring:** a declared 5xx code (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503) still answers its own prose on these faces, where the door withholds every declared 5xx's prose (`Internal server error`) unless the producer marked it `refusal: true`. A CONTROL pins the current answer so the move stays visible. The `delete_records` row fault still quotes the faulting row's thrown text, which #31246 pinned on purpose.
